title: HtmlPicture
responsibility: Renders the native picture element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlPicture.attributes
inputs.description: Native picture attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlPicture.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native picture element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlPicture
outputs.description: The actual native picture element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
